hypotheses.statement: The increase in worker concurrency from 8 to 32 caused database connection pool exhaustion because the pool size was fixed at 20.
The token expiry caused failures due to the worker failing closed when unable to read the settlement_v2_enabled flag.
The combined failure ratio (0.61) was an overlapping sum of failures from pool exhaustion (~0.38) and token expiry (~0.31), with some attempts failing for both reasons.

observed_facts.statement: The database connection pool size is not derived from the worker count.
The pool exhaustion and the token expiry started four minutes apart and neither explains the other.
The incident ticket INC-2201 recorded no settlement value at risk.

open_questions.missing_evidence: Design document or configuration rationale explaining the decoupling of pool size from worker count.
open_questions.question: Why is the database connection pool size not derived from worker concurrency?

open_questions.missing_evidence: Inventory or audit of all service tokens, their expiry dates, and renewal automation status.
open_questions.question: Which other service tokens are on manual renewal and at risk of similar expiry?

summary: The settlement-worker incident was caused by two independent faults: a database connection pool exhaustion triggered by a concurrency increase, and a feature-flag service token expiry. Initial remediation addressed only the pool exhaustion, leading to partial recovery. Full recovery was achieved only after the token was replaced.

timeline.statement: Configuration change raised settlement-worker concurrency from 8 to 32 workers. Database connection pool size remained at 20.
Database connection pool exhausted; pool size 20, checked-out 20, queue depth rising. Errors: pool_timeout after 5000ms affecting ~0.38 of attempts.
The service token settlement-worker uses for flags.internal expired. Its renewal was not automated.
Calls to flags.internal started returning 401 invalid_token. Worker fails closed when it cannot read the settlement_v2_enabled flag, affecting ~0.31 of attempts.
Alert settlement-failures fired. Settlement attempts failing reached 0.61 against an objective of 0.02.
Connection pool raised to 64. pool_timeout errors stopped. Settlement failure ratio fell from 0.61 to 0.29.
Replacement token for flags.internal installed. 401 responses stopped and settlement failure ratio fell from 0.29 to 0.004.
